role: triage (record-correction, offline: no browser, no GPU, no game-code change)
brief: 31 pieces sitting in orchestration/status/*.json with a non-terminal state (building/measuring/running/in_progress) and no agent working them. Determine DONE/PARTIAL/ABANDONED/SUPERSEDED/UNRESOLVED for each, checked against the branch, never against the status file's own claim.
headline: Found 32, not 31 (one hyphenated 'in-progress' state a literal-underscore match misses -- W1-CROSSING-r2). Re-discovered, independently, the same mtime-unreliability bug OWNERSHIP-SWEEP-20260814 diagnosed for conflict detection: W1-18's status file read 11.5h old by mtime and is actually 122.1h (5.1 days) old by git-log date -- a 10.6x error that would have misdirected a fresh dispatch at a five-day-stale brief the branch has already answered four times over. Found and verified, independently of that sweep, a third confirmed instance of the day's recurring pattern: real work landing under an orchestrator bank commit's unrelated headline while the origin status file never learns of it -- W1-20-r3-remediation's four numbered remediation items are all landed on HEAD but arrived inside commit 1be74605 ('HAZARDS 9: ...'), a commit about unrelated tooling.

counts.reason_for_discrepancy: W1-CROSSING-r2's state is the literal string 'in-progress' (hyphen); a naive scan for 'in_progress' (underscore) misses it. Word-boundary matching after normalising _/- to spaces (the same normalisation OWNERSHIP-SWEEP-20260814 applied to its own terminal-vocabulary regex) catches it.

flag_real_work_at_risk.what: Four newer report artifacts (reports/door-yaw/sweep-before.json, consume-archon-apothecary.json, sweep-after.json, sweep-no-refine.json) exist only on this container's local disk. Caught by reports/.gitignore's blanket rule, never committed, never force-added via tools/verdict-evidence.mjs per HAZARDS.md section 9's requirement for cited evidence.
flag_real_work_at_risk.risk: A container restart before someone commits or PINs these four files loses the in-game sweep arms and the CONSUMPTION demonstration; a future agent would re-run an expensive browser sweep (up to 610s/row under load, per this piece's own contention notes) for nothing.
flag_real_work_at_risk.action_taken: Flagged in the piece's own triage.evidence and in this dispatch's report. Not fixed directly -- fixing it means either committing the artifacts (not this dispatch's call, since 'change no game code' and these are evidence, not code, but committing on someone else's behalf risks contradicting an in-progress agent) or running tools/verdict-evidence.mjs --recover, which was out of scope for a triage-only dispatch. Recommend the orchestrator or a fresh dispatch do this before the next restart.

root_causes.1_mtime_unreliability_confirmed_a_second: OWNERSHIP-SWEEP-20260814 already fixed this for conflict detection (tools/ownership.mjs now uses git log -1 --format=%ct, not fs mtime). This dispatch found the same bug corrupting a DIFFERENT computation -- piece age / staleness, which is what the dispatch's whole '17 recent vs 14 dead' prioritisation rested on. Measured: W1-18 off by 10.6x, W1-19-builder-codex-persistent-20260811 off by 6.6x, two more W1-19/W1-30 pieces off by 2-3x. Fix: any staleness computation should read git-log date, never mtime. tools/stranded-check.mjs does this by construction.
root_causes.2_work_lands_under_an_unrelated_bank_hea: Confirmed a third time today (after OWNERSHIP-SWEEP-20260814's two: critic-w1-20, critic-w1-attr-scale). W1-20-r3-remediation's full remediation landed inside 1be74605, a bank commit about an unrelated HAZARDS fix. bank.mjs/land.mjs already print an ownership-registry accounting of whose work each commit carries, but nothing writes that back into the named pieces' own status files -- the agent whose turn already ended cannot do it, and nothing else does either. Proposed fix (not built this dispatch): bank.mjs appends a bank_carried:{commit,date} marker to any task's status file whose paths it just carried, for any task still showing a non-terminal state.
root_causes.3_second_field_naming_variant: Some status files (W1-00-fix2.json) use outputs_written/outputs_expected instead of files_touched/files_claimed -- a sibling bug to the status/state fallback OWNERSHIP-SWEEP-20260814 already fixed structurally. Caused that sweep's own provisional pass to undercount W1-00-fix2 as declaring nothing; corrected in this dispatch's triage. tools/stranded-check.mjs reads both variants.

mechanical_check_built.what_it_does: For every non-terminal status file: computes its true age via git log (never mtime); flags any files_touched/files_claimed/outputs_written/outputs_expected path with commits landed after the status file's own last commit ('post-status-commit' drift); flags any next_step-named corpus/90-verdicts/** path that already exists on disk (the technique OWNERSHIP-SWEEP-20260814 used by hand, automated here). Warning-only: never edits a file, always exits 0 on a normal scan.
mechanical_check_built.proven_to_fire: node tools/stranded-check.mjs --self-test -- two positive fixtures (W1-20-r3-remediation before this dispatch's own fix, W1-DOOR-YAW-SWEEP which stays non-terminal across repeat runs) plus one negative arm (a synthetic state:"done" is confirmed NOT flagged). Exit 0 on pass, non-zero if neither fixture flags.
mechanical_check_built.live_scan_result: As run at the end of this dispatch: 33 non-terminal status files scanned (one more than the 32 found at the top of the dispatch -- the tree moved during the triage itself, expected on this fleet), 30 flagged for human verification. High recall by design; hub files (>=5 post-status commits) and reports/blog-feed.jsonl (union-merged, no per-piece signal) are explicitly annotated or excluded rather than trusted blindly.
mechanical_check_built.not_done_this_dispatch: Wiring the check into tools/dispatchable.mjs's own report output, and the bank.mjs producer-side fix named in root_causes.2. Both are the natural next step and were out of scope for a triage-only pass.

next_step: None for this dispatch. For the fleet: (1) commit or PIN W1-DOOR-YAW-SWEEP's four at-risk artifacts before the next container restart; (2) wire tools/stranded-check.mjs into dispatchable.mjs's report; (3) consider the bank.mjs bank_carried marker described in root_causes.2 to stop this class recurring.
